items.note: Opening line frames the decision as keeping Postgres with pgvector vs adopting a dedicated vector database.
About 5M embeddings at 1536 dimensions, growing about 1M per quarter.
Already runs Postgres 16 on AWS RDS.
Budget under $500 per month, and the prompt asks for cost to be checked against it.
Every query must filter by tenant_id (multi-tenant).
Cut the list to at most 4 options.
Output is a comparison table plus one clear recommendation (and a list of unknowns).
Use only sources from the last 12 months (since 2025-10-07) and flag older ones. This is somewhat stricter than 'prefer', but it is consistent with the stated intent.
Phase 1 is a wide scan and Phase 2 goes deep on the top 2.
